review: The test creates an actual SimProjectile and invokes the existing resolver seam; it cannot pass merely because the sprite asset exists.
The expectation remains missle_fly, the same resource used by the homing missile.
The test does not replace the simulation lifecycle test, which separately proves the delayed strike and preserved next player turn.
The red marker is created only after TrySetOrbitalTarget succeeds; cleanup uses the same controller path for selection and confirmation.
